scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @sky-bar/api" "npm run dev -w @sky-bar/web"
scripts.start:e2e:ci: npm run build && concurrently -k -s first -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run start -w @sky-bar/api" "npm run preview:e2e -w @sky-bar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sky-bar/shared && npm run build -w @sky-bar/api && npm run build -w @sky-bar/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sky-bar/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sky-bar/api && npm run typecheck -w @sky-bar/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
